caption: The drawing depicts a segment of an ornate, wrought-iron fence rendered in black ink on a light beige or off-white background. The fence consists of vertical and horizontal bars forming rectangular panels, with a repeating pattern of interlocking hexagons and diamond shapes in the center. The tops of the fence sections are adorned with vertical posts that are capped with decorative finials shaped like stylized fleurs-de-lis. The image includes three main panels of the fence, with the middle panel framed clearly; the left and right borders partially show segments of adjacent panels. All elements are illustrated with thick, dark outlines and a stippled texture fills the areas inside and between the bars, contributing to the overall intricate appearance of the fence structure.
title: Cast Iron Rail and Gate
